In the Fig. 2 maps, do the stripes slope the same way as in the CD reference maps of Fig. 1e–f?
At the half fillings, did repeated fixed-field sweeps show the hysteresis seen at ν = 2/3 (Fig. S13), and what is the ADG leakage?
How many edges are bound to the antidot at each half filling, and how do p ≈ 10, 2 and 6 (p. 4) follow from that count?
